summary: Terratrace is a website that helps to see changes in earth. it shows how earth's temperature change over time using NASA modis satellite data. Terratrace answers the challenge by giving users the tools to become Earth system trend detectives. important because temperature trends show the earth's temperature in several regions.
details: how it works Users open the Terratrace website and view a graph of the Earth's temperature change trends from year to year. The expected impact is that people will become more aware of changes in their environment. The benefit is that we can find out if there are changes, and NASA data that was previously complicated can be easily understood. The tools used are HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and publishing them via GitHub. How creative is it? I don't think it's very creative, but I can show the changes that have been made in the earth.
